title: HtmlFieldset
responsibility: Renders the native fieldset element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlFieldset.attributes
inputs.description: Native fieldset attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlFieldset.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native fieldset element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlFieldset
outputs.description: The actual native fieldset element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
